summary: P0 Bug Sprint — Moodboard PRO editor (Master Layouts™ + Layers panel ±1 swap + canvas non-mutating scaling). Backend 14/14 NEW + 32/33 regression (1 unrelated F.1 save-as flaky network timeout). Frontend live verified: skeleton picker modal opens with 12 expected cards in IT, picking quote_page closes modal + creates page with 3 placeholder blocks; Livelli panel shows 3 layer-row testids; arrow backward swaps middle row with its lower neighbor (±1) NOT to bottom, and forward restores; canvas does NOT overlap right sidebar at 1920x800 (canvas right=1596, aside left=1620) NOR at 1280x720 (canvas right=956, aside left=980); no horizontal scroll at either viewport. ALL FOUR P0 BUGS RESOLVED + Master Layouts™ Add-Page picker working end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/moodboards/_meta/page_skeletons returns exactly 12 skeletons with id/label_key/category_key/page_type/aspect_ratio/width/height/blocks_preview/block_count — verified blank has 0 blocks, quote_page has 3 blocks (editorial_3_4 1400x1866), hero_full_bleed has 3 blocks (cover_landscape 1920x1200).

POST /api/moodboards/{id}/pages/from_skeleton: persists settings.skeleton_id, auto-appends sort_order at end (verified > existing max), seeds N placeholder blocks via moodboard_elements with proper position_json, returns 404 for unknown skeleton_id, and is tenant-scoped via _assert_moodboard (cross-tenant studio2 returns 403/404). PageFromSkeleton Pydantic model exposes optional title + sort_order.

Frontend SkeletonPicker.jsx renders all 12 cards with data-testid=skeleton-card-{id} grouped by category_key (Copertina/Narrazione/...). Italian i18n active by default: modal title 'Scegli un layout di pagina', categories COPERTINA/NARRAZIONE visible. Picking quote_page POSTs to from_skeleton, closes the modal, switches active page, and the canvas renders 3 placeholder blocks immediately (verified data-testid block-* count = 3).

Layer arrow ±1 swap (nudgeLayer in MoodboardEditor.jsx) verified: initial order [A,B,C] → backward on B → [A,C,B] (swap with lower neighbor on SAME page, no jump to bottom). Forward on bottom row restores [A,B,C]. PASS — the user's exact reported bug (#3) is fixed.

Canvas non-mutating scaling: at 1920x800 viewport canvas occupies x=644..1596 (width 952) and right sidebar starts at 1620 — gap of 24px, no overlap, no horizontal scroll. At 1280x720 canvas auto-scales to width 312 (x=644..956), right sidebar starts at 980. ResizeObserver + canvasScale visual-only approach is working as designed; sortedPageBlocks comparator in editor matches LayersPanel sortLayersTopFirst (sync invariant holds).

Drag & Drop reorder NOT directly automated via Playwright HTML5 drag events (notoriously flaky in Playwright). However, the underlying handleLayerReorder applies contiguous z_index across the whole stack — same code path exercised by the ±1 arrow swaps which DO pass. Recommend manual smoke or future Playwright drag_to() test for full coverage. (Suggestion, not a blocker.)

i18n IT bundle contains all moodboards.skeleton.* keys (hero_full_bleed, quote_page, blank, category.cover, ...) — verified via /api/blueprint/i18n/it. Default tenant locale 'it' confirmed: UI strings render in Italian (Aggiungi blocco, Pagine, Livelli, Copertina, Citazione, Mood, Scegli un layout di pagina).

One pre-existing flaky test in F.1 regression (test_save_as_template_snapshots_multipage) timed out at 30s waiting on /api/templates/{id}/apply during a multi-page snapshot. Re-running F.1 in isolation passed earlier (iteration_13). This is environmental network jitter on the long re-apply call, NOT a regression caused by P0 changes (which only touched moodboards_v1.py + new page_skeletons.py + frontend editor). Suggest bumping that single test's timeout to 60s.
